gen-vast-shadow-gf-hanuman: Vast Shadow is all vintage flash, every stroke cut to a single width. Hanuman, a refined text serif, rides high in the waist and spreads the terminals of its s, so long paragraphs feel traditional and unhurried.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-kadwa: Eye-catching and a bit vintage, Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width with no swelling in the bowls. Kadwa takes over below, its open-ended curves and large x-height making a serif that reads editorial and easy over many lines.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-pridi: Vast Shadow's horizontal bars are exactly as heavy as its upright stems, giving it a flat, vintage punch. And Pridi, a text serif with small letters standing nearly capital-sized, brings a refined, classic softness that loosens everything up.
gen-vt323-fs-literata: Commanding and cyberpunk, VT323 crowds its letters tight with no hairlines anywhere, so it hits hardest big and short. Literata, a bookish text serif, is made for short stretches of reading.
gen-zen-dots-gf-kadwa: Zen Dots leaves lots of room around every letter, and its openings stay generous at every weight, which gives it a friendly tech look. Kadwa's taller lowercase adds a text serif's editorial weight beneath.
gen-zen-dots-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s that keep a text serif readable. Zen Dots above it adds a friendly tech note.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that feel modern. And Almendra Display, ornate and literary, does its best work big and brief up above.
gen-almendra-display-gf-farro: Farro keeps its ascenders compressed and its strokes uniform. Over a long stretch it reads steady and approachable, like one pen pressure from first letter to last, while Almendra Display supplies the ornate, literary flourish above.
gen-almendra-display-gf-inder: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. And Inder, a clean sans-serif with little height difference between cases, wants a modest body size so it stays crisp and professional.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Ornate, bookish, unmistakable: that's Almendra Display. Kdam Thmor Pro's bowls fill the line with a contemporary, modern sans-serif solidity, and its plain build gives the decorative heading plenty of space to stand out.
